If `members` is non-null\n// (single-seed replay of the winning seed) the member list is written there.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_SIZE) void qtCandidateClusterKernel(\n    const double2* __restrict__ points,\n    const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n    const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n    const int num_seeds,\n    const double threshold,\n    const int point_count,\n    double* __restrict__ scratch_dist,\n    int* __restrict__ scratch_list,\n    int* __restrict__ card,\n    int* __restrict__ members) {\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid & 31;\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n    const double INF = __longlong_as_double(0x7FF0000000000000LL);\n\n    // Per-block scratch: maximum distance to the cluster for every point plus\n    // two buffers holding the compacted list of still-viable candidates.\n    double* max_dist = scratch_dist + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;\n    int* list_cur = scratch_list + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * 2 * point_count;\n    int* list_next = list_cur + point_count;\n\n    __shared__ int s_count;      // atomic fill counter of the candidate list\n    __shared__ int s_active;     // broadcast copy of s_count\n    __shared__ int s_best;       // index of the point to append, -1 if none\n    __shared__ double s_warp_val[NUM_WARPS];\n    __shared__ int s_warp_idx[NUM_WARPS];\n\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < num_seeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seeds[s];\n        const double2 sp = points[seed];\n\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            s_count = 0;\n            if (members) members[0] = seed;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // First growth step: distances to the seed alone, building the initial\n        // candidate list of all unclustered points closer than the threshold.\n        double best_val = INF;\n        int best_idx = -1;\n        for (int i = tid; i < point_count; i += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n            if (clustered[i] || i == seed) continue;\n            const double d = gpuDistance(points[i], sp);\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                max_dist[i] = d;\n                list_cur[atomicAdd(&s_count, 1)] = i;\n                argMinUpdate(best_val, best_idx, d, i);\n            }\n        }\n\n        int cardinality = 1;\n        int active;\n        for (;;) {\n            // Block-wide argmin plus broadcast of the candidate list length.\n            warpArgMin(best_val, best_idx);\n            if (lane == 0) {\n                s_warp_val[warp] = best_val;\n                s_warp_idx[warp] = best_idx;\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            if (warp == 0) {\n                best_val = (lane < NUM_WARPS) ? s_warp_val[lane] : INF;\n                best_idx = (lane < NUM_WARPS) ? s_warp_idx[lane] : -1;\n                warpArgMin(best_val, best_idx);\n                if (lane == 0) {\n                    s_best = best_idx;\n                    s_active = s_count;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n\n            const int last = s_best;\n            if (last < 0) break;  // No more points can be added\n            active = s_active;\n\n            if (tid == 0) {\n                if (members) members[cardinality] = last;\n                s_count = 0;\n            }\n            cardinality++;\n\n            // Extend the cluster by `last`: update the running maximum distance\n            // of every candidate and drop the ones that now exceed the\n            // threshold while re-compacting the candidate list.\n            const double2 lp = points[last];\n            best_val = INF;\n            best_idx = -1;\n            __syncthreads();\n            for (int k = tid; k < active; k += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n                const int i = list_cur[k];\n                if (i == last) continue;\n                double v = max_dist[i];\n                const double d = gpuDistance(points[i], lp);\n                if (d > v) v = d;\n                if (v < threshold) {\n                    max_dist[i] = v;\n                    list_next[atomicAdd(&s_count, 1)] = i;\n                    argMinUpdate(best_val, best_idx, v, i);\n                }\n            }\n            int* tmp = list_cur;\n            list_cur = list_next;\n            list_next = tmp;\n        }\n\n        if (tid == 0) card[s] = cardinality;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Device-side state of the clustering run, allocated once per invocation\nstruct GpuContext {\n    double2* points = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* clustered = nullptr;\n    int* seeds = nullptr;\n    int* card = nullptr;\n    int* members = nullptr;\n    double* scratch_dist = nullptr;\n    int* scratch_list = nullptr;\n    int max_blocks = 0;\n};\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (GPU accelerated)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    // Pick a block count: at most one block per seed, bounded by what the GPU\n    // can keep resident and by the per-block scratch memory that fits.\n    int sm_count = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&sm_count, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, 0));\n    size_t free_mem = 0, total_mem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_mem, &total_mem));\n    const size_t bytes_per_block =\n        static_cast<size_t>(N) * (sizeof(double) + 2 * sizeof(int));\n    const size_t budget = (free_mem > (64u << 20)) ? (free_mem - (64u << 20)) / 2 : 0;\n    size_t blocks_by_mem = budget / bytes_per_block;\n    if (blocks_by_mem < 1) blocks_by_mem = 1;\n\n    GpuContext ctx;\n    ctx.max_blocks = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(\n        {static_cast<size_t>(N), static_cast<size_t>(sm_count) * 32, blocks_by_mem}));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.points, sizeof(double2) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.clustered, sizeof(unsigned char) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.seeds, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.card, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.members, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.scratch_dist,\n                          sizeof(double) * N * static_cast<size_t>(ctx.max_blocks)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.scratch_list,\n                          sizeof(int) * 2 * N * static_cast<size_t>(ctx.max_blocks)));\n\n    // Points are stored as double2 for 16-byte coalesced loads\n    std::vector<double2> host_points(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        host_points[i] = make_double2(points[i].x, points[i].y);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.points, host_points.data(), sizeof(double2) * N,\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.clustered, clustered.data(), sizeof(unsigned char) * N,\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    std::vector<int> cardinalities(N);\n    std::vector<int> best_cluster_members(N);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int num_seeds = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.seeds, unclustered_indices.data(),\n                              sizeof(int) * num_seeds, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed, one block per seed\n        const int blocks = std::min(num_seeds, ctx.max_blocks);\n        qtCandidateClusterKernel<<<blocks, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(\n            ctx.points, ctx.clustered, ctx.seeds, num_seeds, threshold, N,\n            ctx.scratch_dist, ctx.scratch_list, ctx.card, nullptr);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cardinalities.data(), ctx.card, sizeof(int) * num_seeds,\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        for (int i = 0; i < num_seeds; ++i) {\n            if (cardinalities[i] > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinalities[i];\n                best_seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            }\n        }\n\n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            // Replay the winning seed to recover its member list\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.seeds, &best_seed, sizeof(int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            qtCandidateClusterKernel<<<1, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(\n                ctx.points, ctx.clustered, ctx.seeds, 1, threshold, N,\n                ctx.scratch_dist, ctx.scratch_list, ctx.card, ctx.members);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(best_cluster_members.data(), ctx.members,\n                                  sizeof(int) * max_cardinality, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members.assign(best_cluster_members.begin(),\n                                   best_cluster_members.begin() + max_cardinality);\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[cluster.members[i]] = 1;\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.clustered, clustered.data(),\n                                  sizeof(unsigned char) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; (__any_sync(0xFFFFFFFFu, tie_hint || nearTie(best_m2, reduced))) {\n                    resolveTies(list_next, count, max_dist, ids, best_slot, best_id);\n                }\n            }\n\n  // Publish the cardinality so that other warps can prune, and keep the\n        // largest cluster of this warp (ties keep the lower seed index).\n        if (lane == 0) atomicMax(const_cast<int*>(global_max), cardinality);\n        if (cardinality > best_card || (cardinality == best_card && seed_id < best_seed)) {\n            best_card = cardinality;\n            best_seed = seed_id;\n            const int tmp = best_buf;\n            best_buf = cur_buf;\n            cur_buf = tmp;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        warp_best[3 * gwarp + 0] = qtSelectWinnerKernel(\n    const int* __restrict__ warp_best,\n    const int num_warps,\n    const int* __restrict__ scratch_members,\n    const int point_count,\n    const int* __restrict__ slot_of,\n    int* __restrict__ work_counter,\n    int* __restrict__ global_max,\n    int* __restrict__ result) {\n    __shared__ int s_card[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int s_seed[BLOCK_SIZE];\n        warp = w;\n        }\n    }\n    s_card[tid] = card;\n    s_seed[tid] = seed;\n    s_warp[tid] = warp;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int offset = BLOCK_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {\n s_seed[tid]))) {\n                s_card[tid] = c;\n                s_seed[tid] = sd;\n                s_warp[tid] = s_warp[tid + offset];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n tid; i < card; i += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        clustered[slot_of[members[i]]] = 1;\n    }\n}\n\n// Uniform grid over the points with a cell size of at least the threshold, so\n// that every point closer than the threshold lies in the 3x3 cell neighbourhood\nstatic const int MAX_GRID_CELLS = 1 << 22;\n\n// Device-side state of the clustering run, allocated once per invocation\nstruct GpuContext {\n    void* memory = nullptr;      // single allocation backing everything below\n    double2* points = nullptr;\n    int* ids = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* clustered = nullptr;\n    int* cell_start = double* scratch_dist = nullptr;\n    int* scratch_list = nullptr;\n    int* scratch_members = nullptr;\n    int max_blocks = 0;\n};\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (GPU accelerated)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    // Smallest squared distance whose square root reaches the threshold, so\n    // that \"squared distance < threshold2\" is {\n            threshold2 = std::nextafter(threshold2, 0.0);\n        }\n    } else {\n        do {\n            threshold2 = std::nextafter(threshold2, std::numeric_limits<double>::max());\n        } CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_mem, &total_mem));\n    // Scratch per warp: distances, two candidate lists, two member lists\n    const size_t bytes_per_warp =\n        static_cast<size_t>(N) * all device memory is one slab allocation.\n\n## Preserving the semantics\n\nTwo things were fragile and are handled explicitly:\n\n1. **Tie-breaking.** The sequential scan picks the lowest point index when two candidates have exactly equal distance. Reductions carry `(distance, original index)` and the parallel order never affects the outcome; cardinality ties likewise compare seed indices.\n2. **Distances.** The hot loops work on *squared* distances (FP64 `sqrt` on this GPU costs ~1.5× the whole kernel). That is exact — `max(sqrt a, sqrt b) == sqrt(max(a,b))`, and the host computes the exact squared threshold boundary via `nextafter`. The only place the domains can differ is two distances collapsing onto the same double after `sqrt`; a cheap integer ULP test detects that and falls back to an exact `sqrt` pass, which essentially never fires.\n\n`--fmad=false` keeps `dx*dx + dy*dy` matching the host's rounding.
